refactor: burn down frontend lint debt and ratchet lint (phase 4a) (#125)

* refactor: remove unused variables and imports

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(lint): allow non-component exports in ui primitives and contexts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: keep device notes edited in mock mode

Mock mode wrote notes into behavioral.notes behind an `as any`, but the list
reads device.notes, so the edit was silently lost. Store it on the device like
the real API path does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: replace explicit any with real types in app code and tests

Use the API client return types in ApplicationUsageDashboard, declare
window.errorTracker globally (renaming the misspelled vite-end.d.ts and dropping
its unused Spark globals), use typed mockData fixtures and vi.mocked() in
useApiData tests, and a named fetchMock / unknown casts for test doubles.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: derive capture and stale-snapshot state in useApiData

Replace two setState-in-effect syncs with derived values (a start/stop
override that expires on the next health poll, and the snapshot flag from the
queries isFetched state), list USE_REAL_API as a hook dependency, and use a
shared empty-array fallback so the snapshot-save effect stops re-running every
render while queries are empty. FlowDetailView now fetches by flow.id instead
of reading a variable declared later in render.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: keep render pure in App, DataExporter, DashboardTab and MaintenancePanel

Add a useNow() hook instead of Date.now() during render, compute DataExporter
default dates and mock-mode trend labels once via lazy useState (the trend
labels previously re-rolled on every render), and declare MaintenancePanel
refreshStats before the effect that calls it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: replace setState-in-effect syncs with derived and initial state

- FlowFilters, SearchBar, useFlowFilters presets: adjust state during render
  when the input changes instead of in an effect (SearchBar also stops
  re-running its effect every render on a fresh default results object)
- useDataSource mock data, AuthContext loading, dashboard loading flags:
  lazy/initial state instead of setting it on mount
- useFlowFilters: drop the shouldFetch flag that only delayed auto-fetch by a
  render
- ThemeToggle: drop the SSR hydration guard (client-only SPA)
- useThroughputGauge: track the peak during render; the decay tick stamps the
  hold start

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(lint): make explicit any an error and cap warnings at 5

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: re-open search results when a cached search is repeated

Track every data transition in the auto-show marker, including back to
undefined, so a repeated search served from the query cache still opens the
dialog. Adds a regression test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: consolidate docs and scripts (phase 3) (#121)

* chore: remove one-off Pi fix scripts and consolidate scripts reference

Delete unreferenced fix-*/restart/kill-port scripts, PowerShell duplicates,
obsolete host-diagnose/log-tail/tunnel-test scripts and setup-cloudflare-env.sh
(Pages env vars never reach the prebuilt CI bundle). scripts/README.md is now
the single reference; docs/SCRIPTS_REFERENCE.md is removed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: merge deployment, tunnel and env docs into DEPLOYMENT.md

Replace five overlapping guides (several described a nonexistent deploy.yml,
Node 20, and Pages-dashboard env vars that never reach the prebuilt CI bundle)
with one accurate page. TROUBLESHOOTING.md now covers only the Pi backend and
keeps the capture tips from the deleted fix scripts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: merge capture placement, internals and extraction docs into CAPTURE.md

Condense three overlapping docs into one, verified against
services/packet_capture/service.py (5-minute flow eviction, not 60s; BPF
filter and sampling are not configurable today). Keeps the remote_ssh setup
and the UDM Pro port-mirroring gotcha.

chore(backend): widen ruff rules, format, and add service tests (phase 4b) (#124)

* refactor(backend): widen ruff rules and apply safe autofixes

Select E, F, W, I, UP and B (ignoring E501 and FastAPI-idiomatic B008) with
py311 target, and apply ruff's safe fixes: PEP 604/585 annotations,
collections.abc imports, sorted imports, datetime.UTC, TimeoutError alias.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(backend): chain re-raised HTTPExceptions and remove bare excepts

Add `from e` to 15 HTTPException re-raises so the original cause stays in
tracebacks, replace two bare `except:` with `except Exception:`, move
error_handler imports to the top, use StrEnum for UserRole, and mark the
intentional late imports in main.py and conftest.py with noqa.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* style(backend): apply ruff format

* test(backend): cover threat scoring and device fingerprinting

Add unit tests for ThreatDetectionService (score thresholds, abrupt-reset
regression guard, RTT sample averaging, classification, storage failure) and
DeviceFingerprintingService (DHCP naming, MAC reuse, new-device alerts, type
heuristics, fallback names, backfill).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(backend): require Python 3.11+ in installer and docs

The backend already targets py311 (ruff, CI) and now uses datetime.UTC and
StrEnum, so stop advertising 3.10.

* test(backend): make RTT averaging assertion able to fail
